title: BudgetEnvelope v1
description: Budget envelope for a campaign. Enforced by the campaign budget accounting. Every dimension is optional: declare only the dimensions this deployment actually meters. An undeclared dimension is absent from budget snapshots (nothing measures it, so no ceiling is invented for it) and rejects topups; declaring a ceiling that no metering path can ever touch states a control that does not exist.

max_nodes.description: Optional hard cap on the total number of IdeaNodes that may be created in this campaign.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific knobs (kept out of the stable surface).
